definitions.explanation: A smaller dish that accompanies the main dish in a meal. Typically vegetables or lighter preparations that complement the main course.

examples.japanese: {副菜|ふくさい}に{野菜|やさい}の{煮物|にもの}を{作|つく}りました。
examples.english: I made simmered vegetables as a side dish.

examples.japanese: {バランス|ばらんす}の{良|よ}い{食事|しょくじ}には{副菜|ふくさい}が{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: Side dishes are important for a balanced meal.

examples.japanese: {副菜|ふくさい}を{二|に}{品|ひん}{用意|ようい}しました。

notes:
{副菜|ふくさい} refers to side dishes that accompany the main course.

{副|ふく} = secondary/sub, {菜|さい} = dish

Typical side dishes:
- {煮物|にもの} (simmered dishes)
- {和|あ}え{物|もの} (dressed dishes)
- {酢|す}の{物|もの} (vinegared dishes)
- お{浸|ひた}し (boiled greens with dashi)
- サラダ (salad)

Meal structure:
- {主食|しゅしょく} (staple - rice, bread)
- {主菜|しゅさい} (main dish - protein)
- {副菜|ふくさい} (side dish - vegetables)
- {汁物|しるもの} (soup)

Nutritional role:
- Provides vitamins and minerals
- Adds variety and color
- Balances the meal nutritionally
